lobbyInfo.whyIntro: SNAKE168 brings online games from many providers together on one website, with menus for your account, deposits and withdrawals, transaction history, promotions and contacting our team. It works on both phones and computers.
lobbyInfo.f1Text: Deposit and withdraw on the Wallet page, and see your account's transactions on the History page.
lobbyInfo.f2Text: See your member details and registered bank account on the Profile page. Withdrawals are paid only to the registered account.
lobbyInfo.f3Text: Browse games from {{n}} providers in slots, live casino, card games, fishing and sports, all in one Lobby.
lobbyInfo.f3TextNoCount: Browse games from many providers in slots, live casino, card games, fishing and sports, all in one Lobby.
lobbyInfo.f4Text: See the promotions that are open, with each one's minimum deposit, maximum bonus and turnover conditions.
lobbyInfo.f5Text: Ask our team about using the site through LINE or Telegram, using the channels shown on the website.
lobbyInfo.f6Text: Use SNAKE168 in a web browser on phones and computers; the pages adapt to your screen size.
lobbyInfo.q1: How do I sign up for SNAKE168?
lobbyInfo.a1: Choose “<register>Register</register>”, fill in every field of the form, including the bank account that receives your withdrawals, then follow the steps on screen.
lobbyInfo.q2: How do I deposit and withdraw on SNAKE168?
lobbyInfo.a2: <login>Log in</login>, open the <wallet>Wallet</wallet> menu, choose Deposit or Withdraw, and check the details before you confirm.
lobbyInfo.a2Min: The current minimum deposit is {{min}} THB.
lobbyInfo.q3: How long does a withdrawal take?
lobbyInfo.a3: Each withdrawal is reviewed and approved by our team, so the time it takes can vary. The money is paid only to your <profile>registered account</profile>, and completed transactions appear on the <history>History</history> page.
lobbyInfo.a3Min: The current minimum withdrawal is {{min}} THB.
lobbyInfo.q4: What kinds of games does SNAKE168 have?
lobbyInfo.a4: The site has slots, live casino, card games, fishing and sports; browse games from the available providers in the Lobby.
lobbyInfo.q5: Where can I check promotions and their conditions?
lobbyInfo.a5: Open the <promotions>Promotions</promotions> menu to see the promotions that are open, with each one's minimum deposit, maximum bonus and turnover conditions.
lobbyInfo.q6: Can I play on my phone?
lobbyInfo.a6: Yes. The site works in a web browser on phones and computers, and adapts its menus and layout to your screen.
lobbyInfo.q7: How do I contact the SNAKE168 team?
lobbyInfo.a7: Open the Contact menu to see the LINE or Telegram channels the website provides.
lobbyInfo.a7Links: Use the LINE or Telegram button below, or open the Contact menu to see the channels the website provides.
